principles.rule: Hedge emotionally high-stakes events to protect your wellbeing, not just your wallet
principles.rationale: Stu argues that prediction markets have genuine personal utility beyond profit — when an outcome (like your team winning) has real emotional consequences for your day or year, taking a position on the other side gives you a financial cushion that softens the blow. He frames this as a reason sports and entertainment markets are legitimate and valuable, not frivolous.

citations.quote: As a person who watches the Eagles every single year, my day is good or bad based on the result. There is social value to me to hedge whether the Eagles are going to win or not. I have actually done that on these markets.
